question: When is revenue from the sale of goods recognised under AS 9 'Revenue Recognition'? When should recognition be postponed?

points.label: Transfer of risks and rewards
points.description: The seller has transferred the property in the goods to the buyer for a consideration, i.e. the significant risks and rewards of ownership.

points.label: No significant uncertainty
points.description: No significant uncertainty exists about the measurement or collectability of the consideration.

points.label: No effective control retained
points.description: The seller retains no effective control over the goods to the degree usually associated with ownership.

points.label: Postponement
points.description: Where uncertainty exists at the time of sale, recognition is postponed until it is resolved; if uncertainty arises later, a separate provision is made rather than adjusting revenue.
